rating_definitions.evidence_confidence: quality and coverage of current evidence, not attractiveness

cac_measurement_spec.consumer: Fully loaded CAC = attributable paid-media + creative/agency + influencer/affiliate commissions + growth payroll allocation, divided by first-time paid subscribers acquired in the same cohort. Track by channel, language, city/state and plan; do not use installs/downloads as the denominator.
cac_measurement_spec.b2b: Fully loaded B2B CAC = marketing + sales + solution/onboarding labour attributable to closed accounts, divided by new accounts; pair with sales-cycle length, contract value, activation and renewal.
minimum_cohort_metrics: AI inference cost per active learner
cac_measurement_spec.rule: Do not infer CAC from Meta Ad Library creative counts, download totals, hiring, a funding round or social-media reach.
